# Navigation background location cleanup (2026-08-25 18:55Z)

_**User**_

Reported that the blue system location indicator remained visible on a physical iPhone after backgrounding without an active navigation and after ending navigation with the X button. Clarified that ending navigation must always restore Significant-Change monitoring so Miataru continues normal background tracking.

---

_**Agent**_

Removed the implicit high-accuracy location acquisition during Live Activity launch reconciliation. A restored Activity now receives high-accuracy background location only after a real navigation view registers and enters the background.

Added a hard scene-background reconciliation that clears orphaned background-navigation sessions before resolving the normal tracking policy. Without an active navigation, the resulting service transition restarts the primary Significant-Change monitor, stops the secondary high-frequency manager and its background activity session, and disables the blue location indicator.

Added regression coverage for restored Activities without open navigation views and for the explicit background-navigation-to-Significant-Change service command transition. Updated the test catalog, gap matrix, changelog, and release build metadata.

Verification on the dedicated `miataru Tests - iPhone 16` simulator:

- Focused Navigation Live Activity and location-policy suites: 29 tests passed.
- Full unit target: 340 tests in 36 suites passed.
- All `.xcstrings` passed `jq empty`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
